novels.title: Shadow Rank
novels.description:
At Noctis Vale Academy, every student is assigned a rank.

A number that determines opportunity.

A number that shapes reputation.

A number that can decide a person's future.

When Kael Ardyn arrives, he receives the impossible designation:

Rank #999.

The lowest rank in the academy's history.

With no past records, no entrance evaluation, and no explanation for his admission, Kael quickly becomes the center of quiet suspicion. While classmates dismiss him as a failure, hidden observers buried beneath the academy begin watching his every move.

Because Kael was never meant to be here.

As psychological evaluations, strategic competitions, and dangerous secrets unfold, Kael discovers that Noctis Vale Academy is more than a school—it is an experiment where every decision is recorded, every choice has consequences, and someone is always watching.

Not every mystery deserves an answer.

Not every truth should be uncovered.

Welcome to Shadow Rank.

Genres:

Psychological Mystery • Academy Fantasy • Strategy • Slow Burn • Action

novels.author: shadowx17
novels.title: Shadow of Destiny
novels.description: In a world where Elves, Dwarves, Demi-Hyumans, and Humans coexist alongside legendary creatures like Dragons and Demons, a young hero named Satoru Yuko embarks on a thrilling journey that will test his resolve and redefine his destiny. Exiled from the powerful Zanoya family due to his perceived lack of talent, Satoru discovers his unique ability—"Shadow Resurrection," allowing him to reconstruct and command dead beings as loyal servants, as any other summoner or Necromanceer do. However, his life takes a tragic turn when his mentor and secret love, Asuna Sajima, mysteriously disappears. Determined to find her, Satoru enrolls at Flybrid Academy, a prestigious institution where students from all races train to become Knights, Mages, Summoners,Necromancer, Healers, and Archers. Concealing his exceptional abilities, he navigates a new world filled with potential allies and hidden dangers, all while balancing the challenges of academy life and keeping his true power hidden. "Shadow of Destiny" is a tale of love, determination, and the unyielding pursuit of one's fate. Join Satoru as he uncovers secrets, forms unlikely alliances, and faces formidable adversaries in his quest to reunite with the woman who changed his life forever.

novels.author: shadow_08
novels.title: Shadow of Truth
novels.description:
Truth...

In a world where truth is the source of power, knowledge is not a privilege—it is a weapon.

But what happens when what you know is only a fragment of the truth?

A fragment of the past.

A forgotten secret.

Truths that were never meant to be pieced together.

Sometimes, a lie can destroy a life.

But an incomplete truth... May be something far more dangerous.

novels.author: shadow_hokake08
novels.title: The Shadow Prince
novels.description: The world’s greatest spy—codenamed Phantom—is betrayed and killed by his own country, only to reincarnate as Kael Arcanis, the bastard prince of a medieval fantasy kingdom. Armed with his lethal skills, genius intellect, and newfound magic, he must navigate deadly court politics, build a network of elite spies, and outmaneuver enemies who underestimate him at their peril.

novels.author: Not Another Kevin
novels.title: Shadowstepper
novels.description:
My name is Jay Shen. I’m a street rat alchemist, a former thief, and I live above a fish market in Kowloon, my main goal right now is not getting killed.

I accepted a simple job from Grandma Zaro the herbalist. All I had to do was look and report back. Unfortunately, I misunderstood my assignment, and I may have woken something that is now wreaking havoc on the streets of Hong Kong.

Also, I may have stolen a magic dagger from a guy who just got promoted to head of a Triad clan. We’re not exactly on good terms.

I don’t think there’s a potion that can fix this, but I’ll do my best. Wish me luck.

novels.title: ShadowFall
novels.description:
Growing up as an orphan, Zenil endured a lifetime of relentless bullying, with no one to lean on. One fateful day while getting beaten up as usual, a powerful master stumbles upon the scene. The man gives him the power to rise up, and take back his dignity. But, nothing is free after all. Zenil would have to endure suffering, misery, and misfortune far beyond what he had already known.

According to the prophecy, one day, the whole world will be against him.

novels.author: Midnight Shadow
novels.title: Shadow of the Iceborne
novels.description:
On the distant, hidden planet of Lunareth, five kingdoms thrive under the rule of elemental forces. Four are known, one remains a legend—the kingdom of ice, said to guard a being of unimaginable power.

When whispers of a magical beast escaping into the human realm reach the Ashrnborn Empire, secrets long thought buried stir once more. In the human world, ancient ruins hide forgotten stories, while ambitious leaders and skilled visionaries navigate alliances, power, and ambition.

Amid whispers, rumors, and the clash of hidden powers, one question looms: who truly watches over the balance of the universe—and what happens when the unseen guardian decides it’s time to intervene?

novels.author: Shadow-walking
novels.title: Shadow of the Rifts: Survival Diaries of the Artificially Awakened
novels.description:
A brilliant woman. A besieged planet. And an army of monsters turned into expendable toys.
Elenor Altarez was a low-profile genius on the planet Nevarion, known globally as a master game developer and dubbed the "Empress of Gaming." But when history's greatest "Multi-Rift Fracture" shattered the world and unleashed billions of creatures, neither high-tech power armor nor colossal Mechas were enough to save humanity. While the elites fled in spaceships, those left behind were abandoned to their fates in underground bunkers, trapped in the midst of a bloody slaughter.
In a living hell that cost her everything, Elenor refuses to watch humanity fade into silent extinction. Armed with a photographic memory and a unique device left by her grandfather—integrated directly into her nervous system—she becomes the world’s first Artificial Awakened.
Her strategy is simple yet ruthless: Fight poison with poison.
Ditching traditional hunter methods, Elenor leverages her high IQ to master mind control and hypnosis, turning the very nightmares hunting humanity into her personal, expendable hounds. Those who discover her work call her a psychopath—a mad scientist tearing down ethical boundaries. But in a world drained of ammunition and hope, and crushed under the weight of agonizing moral dilemmas, Elenor has only one goal: to become darkness itself to protect what remains of her family and her empire.
Tactical mecha battles, a ruthless monster-taming system, and a high-stakes logistical struggle for survival await you in this dark sci-fi and Progression Fantasy epic.

novels.author: Shadow xenon
novels.title: The shadow in the lotus
novels.description: Jace was a man who did everything right, only to be betrayed. Now, reborn with 0.01% of a Goddess’s power in a world of magic and swords, he’s playing a different game. He’s the hidden Prince of a fallen throne, and he’s found an ally in a girl the world forgot. The Nobles think they run this Academy. They’re about to find out what happens when a God goes to school.

novels.author: Shadow of the Writer
novels.title: Shadow of the Valkyrie
novels.description:
In silent voids, I shatter metal, life, and dreams. The stars still watch me.

Anna is a killer angel in the cold dark, one of the elite Valkyries who guard humanity’s last sanctuaries. She moves through space like a thought, bonded to a living ship, striking from the black and disappearing again.

But even killers grow tired. Even angels long for something more.

Shadow of the Valkyrie is a story of solitude, survival, and identity—set against the vast, indifferent beauty of deep space.

novels.author: Shadow The New Dawn
novels.title: Shadow: The New Dawn
novels.description:
A man wakes up after ten years of unconsciousness - with no name, no memories, and no identity. His past is gone, erased like it never existed.

Only one person has stayed by his side through those long, silent years: a woman who hides a truth she cannot tell him.

Now, as he tries to rebuild himself piece by piece, the shadows of his forgotten past slowly begin to move again.

This is my first story, so if you find any mistakes or want to suggest improvements, feel free to do so.

I hope you enjoy the journey.

novels.author: SHADOW WALKERS
novels.title: CRIMSON SHADOW VEIL OF THE DARK WORLD
novels.description:
In the bustling cityscape of his mundane life, a weary man trudges home, yearning for the solace of a cold beer at his favourite bar. But as the day fades into night, a chilling sensation envelops him, and the world around him dissolves into an abyss. His final moments are filled with an overwhelming sense of regret and sorrow for the family he is about to leave behind.

When he awakens, he finds himself in a surreal and unfamiliar hospital room. His senses, though muted, confirm that he is no longer in the realm of the living. Instead, he is in a baby’s body, cradled by strangers who speak with a mix of awe and tenderness. The woman gazes at him with joy, declaring him to be the spitting image of her, while the man, his voice rich with pride, identifies himself as the father.

The man’s words reveal a staggering truth: he is no longer in his previous life but has been reborn into a fantastical world called Eldorathys Zephyraar. Here, he is given a new name—REX. The names and surroundings are foreign, and the realization of this new existence hits him with both wonder and disbelief.

As Rex begins to acclimate to his new life, he is thrust into a world teeming with magic, mystery, and adventure. Eldorathys Zephyraar is a realm of ancient prophecies, hidden powers, and epic quests. With his new identity, Rex must navigate this uncharted territory, uncovering the secrets of his past life and the destiny that awaits him in this enigmatic land.

Rex’s journey is just beginning, and as he ventures through the vast and unfamiliar world of Eldorathys Zephyraar, he will encounter allies and adversaries, face trials that test his courage, and unravel the truth behind his extraordinary rebirth. His story is a canvas waiting to be painted with the brushstrokes of fate, and though the path ahead is uncertain, one thing is clear—his tale is far from over.

novels.title: Shadow Overseer
novels.description:
He never had a name.

People had names, not lab rats. The reason for his existence was to further science and die somewhere along the way.

"Subject Five" was what they called him. Under the name of science, they tormented him and derived a sick pleasure from his pain.

His dark life had a single solace in the form of his brothers and sisters sharing the same fate. Helping them escape cost Five his life, but he was happy knowing he did something for himself.

After waking up, he finds himself as the son of a noble in a marvelous world filled with magic. In his second chance at life, he vows to protect himself and his family from anything that threatens to destroy his peaceful life. Follow Five on his path to supremacy.

**********

This is a LITRPG novel, with the system playing a crucial, but supporting role. It isn't omnipotent and has definite origins which I'll explain later in the story. Another important aspect is world-building and crafting. I'll go into quite a lot of detail on both of them.

novels.author: MissingtheMoon
novels.title: Shadow Convergence
novels.description: The core of the first volume's story is William's gradual growth for his wife, becoming a true warrior with Loong's help. He achieves his goal and gains the power he desires......

novels.author: Unknown
novels.title: Shadow Weaver
novels.description: As an aspiring game producer, Xu Yichi is resolute in her mission to create a groundbreaking traditional Chinese game. From that moment forward, she inscribed her name in history, amassed wealth, and achieved the pinnacle of success alongside the sisters in her studio. However, no one ever warned her that she would face monsters while developing games! "You young people ought not to be too conservative or feudal in your thinking~" A young girl clad in a jacket and long skirt sat at the table, munching loudly on a bag of potato chips. While snacking, she pointed at Xu Yichi's screen. "Well, you see, this 'inheritance' (chew chew chew) must first be 'transmitted' before there can be 'inheritance'—if something can't even be conveyed (chew chew chew), how can you expect anyone to 'inherit' it?" "I need you to tell the players a story, not to instruct them on stage performance!" "Go ahead, erase that lengthy and ornate introduction, and make Mu Guiying's portrait look more striking for me—oh, and that little purple clay pot playing with mud next door also wants to take part in our project (chew chew chew), remember to negotiate for more funds from that unfortunate thing." "—The Thirteen Taibao of Su Province are extremely wealthy!" Thus, under the guidance of a group of ancient demon spirits, cultural heritages on the brink of extinction finally blossomed anew in Xu Yichi's game world. novels.author: IseKaizen
novels.title: Shadow’s Pursuit
novels.description: "Shadow's Pursuit" is a gripping tale of family, vengeance, and the unyielding pursuit of justice. It explores the transformation of a boy into a formidable avenger, and the sacrifices made in the name of love and retribution. As Oliver delves deeper into the heart of darkness, he discovers that some secrets are darker than others, and that the true meaning of redemption may lie in the shadows.

novels.author: Shojiro
novels.title: Shadow's Reach
novels.description:
A youth plays a virtual reality game to escape the stresses of his final year of studies. A young man that explores a new world, and finds surprising secrets lurking around every other corner. Cosmos Gate, the game he plays, is not what it seems. Can he save the world of Cosmos Gate from the impending disasters?

A strange beast fights to survive and to protect his clan. Pushed into a position he was not prepared for, and forced to do things he has no confidence he can. Can he save his people? Can he lead them to a brighter tomorrow, free of the evils that are hunting them down?

A young assistant helps an old Emperor with his daily tasks, but often finds himself spending all his time simply listening to the fantastical tales the old man loves to tell. But there are undercurrents in the world of which neither are aware. What will happen with the old man's tales, and what does it mean for the young assistant?

How far do the shadows reach?

novels.author: Darkin
novels.title: Shadow (Hiatus)
novels.description:
The story takes place in a fantasy world. With spell casters, monsters, and war. What would one do if he could claim great power, would he try to stop war, save kingdoms, win a lady's hand, slay dragons, and fulfill his destiny? Or would he create wars to subjugate kingdoms, choose whatever lady he desired, ride dragons, and make his own destiny.

This is the tale not of a hero or an anti-hero, but of a villain and his rise to power in a world as dark as reality.

*Warning* This story contains gruesome acts of violence and such. NOT for the light hearted.

novels.author: Knight_in_pitch_black_armor
novels.title: Shadows Pact
novels.description: In a world filled with magic harnessed through the elements or the gods, a kid who always dreamed of being able to control magic finds out that both the elements and gods have rejected him on his day of ascension. With a heavy heart, he decides it is better to run off and die in the woods than face the disgrace he would bring his family. He finds a book containing secrets to making pacts with beings from other worlds. What would you do to make your dreams come true? Make a sacrifice to a demon? A deal with an angel? Or kill a god?

novels.author: 王珂
novels.title: Shadow Punisher
novels.description: Original Title: 魅影神捕 Author: Wang Ke Raw Link: Mei Ying Shen Bu Male Lead: Luo Yunxi; Fang Yilun; Wang Haixiang Female Lead: Shen Yujie; He Hongshan Synopsis: The corpse flower valley, which stinks for miles, holds crucial clues to the disappearance of over a hundred young girls. Meng Rui ventures alone to solve the case of the missing girls, only to unexpectedly discover his long-lost younger sister, Meng Wanxiang, who has been missing for years. In order to save his sister, Meng Rui faces a series of events and gradually realizes that he has become entangled in the endless vortex of the imperial succession struggle. With constant threats from the royal court faction, the crown prince faction, and the Duke of Ding’s faction, he finds himself surrounded by dangers, with nothing behind him but a bottomless abyss.
